audit.note: The model probability is an estimated winning probability; these strata measure whether the reliability of the supporting information is reflected. A calibration slope below 1 means the log-odds are too wide for that stratum.

research_candidate.definition: favourite <10 prior matches AND confidence in [0.60,0.75)
research_candidate.note: Fitted on 2026-09-10..2026-10-31 only. A slope >= 0.95 means the evidence does not justify a separate candidate; no adjustment is then evaluated or recommended.

reliability_flag.rule: FLAGGED if favourite observed matches <5 OR any unresolved identity OR minimum surface history <5 OR favourite overall/surface divergence >=100 Elo.
reliability_flag.note: Diagnostic only. It does not change p, the selected side, the frozen thresholds or any production policy. A single factor has no aggregate discrimination; only 3+ simultaneous risk factors separate.

existing_mechanisms.note: Agent 1 carries a point estimate. Match counts change the learning rate, and surface counts change the blend, but none of these enter the probability as an explicit reliability term.
